description_en: Queries the list of rate limiting rules
description_zh: 调用ListNatRateLimitRules接口查询限速规则的列表信息
name: ListNatRateLimitRules

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
NAT网关所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的 NAT 网关的 ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the rate limiting rules
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的限速规则的ID列表
parameters.name: rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The source IP address CIDR block of the rate limiting rule
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的限速规则源 IP 地址段
parameters.name: source_cidr

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, and you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If this is your first query or no next query is to be sent, ignore this parameter.

If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the rate limiting rule
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的限速规则名称
parameters.name: rule_name

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query is to be sent.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

RuleInfos.description_en: The list of rate limiting rules
RuleInfos.description_zh: 查询的限速规则信息列表

MatchType.description_en:
The source match type of the rate limiting rule. Valid values:

CIDR: CIDR block match. This is the default value.
TUNNEL: tunnel match. If this value is specified, a corresponding SNAT rule of the TUNNEL type must exist
MatchType.description_zh:
限速 源匹配类型，取值

CIDR：网段匹配（默认值）
TUNNEL：隧道匹配 当取值为 TUNNEL 时，需要有对应的TUNNEL类型的SNAT规则存在

RuleDescription.description_en: The description of the rate limiting rule

RuleId.description_en: The ID of the rate limiting rule

RuleName.description_en: The name of the rate limiting rule

SourceCIDRs.description_en: The source CIDR blocks of the rate limiting rule
SourceCIDRs.description_zh: 限速规则的源IP地址段列表

items.description_en: The source CIDR block of the rate limiting rule

Status.description_en:
The status of the rate limiting rule. Valid values:
Created: The rule is available.
Deleting: The rule is being deleted.
Modifying: The rule is being modified
Status.description_zh:
限速规则状态。
Created：可用。
Deleting：删除中。
Modifying：修改中

TunnelIndex.description_en: The tunnel index. If the MatchType parameter is set to TUNNEL, a corresponding SNAT rule must exist
TunnelIndex.description_zh: 隧道索引，当 MatchType 为 TUNNEL 时，需要有对应的SNAT规则存在

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of rate limiting rules returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询的限速规则的结果个数
